data.name: Hannoria
data.long_meaning: The name Hannoria is derived from the Greek word 'hannos' which means 'mountain'. This name is a feminine form of Hannes, a Greek name meaning 'graceful mountain'. In Christian tradition, this name represents the strength and grace of God, as if He is a mountain that provides protection and stability.
